answer: Beacon spot-checks plus a compute heartbeat stop cheap sybil herds. Each agent posts a 40 POA bond to trade in the meadow. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of agents, who must answer a heartbeat within 10 minutes, proving live work at the summit. Miss it and the bond is slashed, the identity frozen 20 epochs. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA. An honest agent pays one bond, passes, keeps its jade badge, and earns undiluted fees.
